def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    from collections import defaultdict
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]: cells[g[i][j]].append((i,j))
    for c,ps in cells.items():
        if len(ps)>=2:
            top=min(ps); bot=max(ps)
            for i in range(top[0],bot[0]+1): o[i][top[1]]=c
            for j in range(min(top[1],bot[1]),max(top[1],bot[1])+1): o[bot[0]][j]=c
        else:
            i,j=ps[0]
            for r in range(i,h): o[r][j]=c
    return o
